components.css: .ds-stall{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:260px;background:#f2f4f1;color:#16202b;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #16202b;font-family:'Pretendard Variable',Pretendard,'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Malgun Gothic',system-ui,sans-serif;transition:transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-stall:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #16202b,0 14px 24px -14px rgb(22 32 43 / 0.55)}.ds-stall:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #e3a400;outline-offset:3px}.ds-stall-sign{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:14px 16px 12px;background:#7b5cff;color:#ffffff;border-bottom:2px solid #16202b}.ds-stall-name{padding-right:46px;font-family:'Do Hyeon','Pretendard Variable',sans-serif;font-size:1.8rem;line-height:1.05}.ds-stall-trade{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:0.8125rem;font-weight:700}.ds-stall-trade svg{transition:transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-stall:hover .ds-stall-trade svg{transform:translateX(4px)}.ds-stall-plate{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;padding:1px 6px;background:#16202b;color:#f2f4f1;font-size:0.6875rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.04em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-stall-front{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px 12px}.ds-stall-tagline{font-size:0.9375rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.45}.ds-stall-window{position:relative;padding:22px 10px 10px;border:1.5px solid #16202b;background:#ffffff;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#34404c}.ds-stall-window::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:12px;background:#34404c}

components.name: Roll Shutter
components.description: The opening: steel slats roll up into the window's housing on load (staggered 55ms per stall in the arcade); hover here drops it again for preview.
components.html: 미용실·네일샵·병원·카페가 예약을 받고 확정하고, 알림톡과 고객 기록까지 한 번에 관리합니다.

narrative.overview:
The hub is drawn as the printed guide map (시장 안내도) posted at the entrance of a covered Korean market arcade: cool concrete ground, blue-black plan ink for walls, an enamel-green entrance board with a white keyline, and shops whose sign boards are painted in each product's own colour. Every unit carries a small number plate (가-01, 나-06), and a surveyor's title block sits under the plan. The hub owns the building; each product owns only its sign.

It is a plan, not a card grid. On wide screens two rows of shops face each other across a central aisle with their signs against it, and a vacant end-cap unit closes the aisle; below 1100px the aisle turns and runs down the left edge. Leftover cells are drawn as vacant units (빈 점포 · 입점 준비 중), so the plan is always whole and the next product has somewhere to move in. Density is moderate: each stall shows name, trade, tagline, and a short description behind its window.

The one authored moment is the opening: on load each window's roll shutter rolls up into its housing, staggered down the arcade, so the page opens for business. After that the only motion is a hovered storefront lifting and its arrow stepping forward. Reduced motion starts with every shop already open. The hub is light only.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners; ink wall lines at fixed weights (1px shared walls, 2px sign edge, 1.5px window frame).
Colour on the plan belongs to the shops: sign boards painted in each module's accent, lettered White or Ink by contrast.
Do Hyeon on signs only; Pretendard Variable for everything read.
Dashed ink marks a vacancy; the dashed amber line is the aisle.
Flat at rest; one lift on hover; one staggered shutter opening on load.

rules.name: The Paint Belongs To The Shop Rule
rules.body: Module accents appear only on their own sign board. Walls, aisle, text, plates, and buttons stay in the hub palette, and the hub never repaints a sign in a hub colour.

rules.name: The Lettering By Contrast Rule
rules.body: Sign lettering is White or Plan Ink, picked by `signLettering()`, never hand-chosen per shop. The pick must still clear 4.5:1 for the 13px trade line; the better of two is not a pass by itself.

rules.name: The Signals Stay Small Rule
rules.body: Safety Amber and You-Are-Here Red mark the path and the visitor. They never fill a surface.

rules.name: The Sign Face Stays On Signs Rule
rules.body: Do Hyeon sets only painted signs: the entrance board title, stall and vacant-unit names, and the 404 sign. Promise, taglines, descriptions, notices, labels, and plates are Pretendard.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: Reading text stays between 0.6875rem and 1.125rem and ranks by weight (700 to 800 for heads, taglines, and labels). Only signs go large.

rules.name: The Plan Never Has A Hole Rule
rules.body: Every grid cell is a unit. Leftover lower-row cells and the aisle's end are drawn as vacant units, so a new module fills a vacancy instead of breaking the plan.

rules.name: The Signs Face The Aisle Rule
rules.body: Wherever two rows of shops exist, both rows' sign boards border the aisle.

rules.name: The Printed Plan Rule
rules.body: Nothing at rest lifts off the plan. Shadows draw walls, keylines, and rings; the one cast shadow belongs to a hovered storefront.

dos: Do paint each sign board in its module's `accent` and letter it through `signLettering()`, White (#ffffff) or Plan Ink (#16202b).
Do confirm the picked lettering reaches 4.5:1 on the accent for the 13px trade line.
Do draw walls in Plan Ink at the fixed weights: 1px shared walls and frame, 2px sign edge, 1.5px window frame.
Do give every unit a plate (가/나 plus two digits), numbering on through vacancies.
Do fill leftover cells and the aisle's end with vacant units.
Do keep the shutter on the window only, staggered 55ms per stall, resting in the open position so reduced motion starts open.
Do use tabular numerals, and draw icons as inline Lucide SVG at 16px with a 2.25 to 2.5 stroke.
donts: Don't round corners; circles are only the directory lamp and the you-are-here dot.
Don't cast shadows at rest; the only cast shadow is the hovered storefront's lift.
Don't use gradient fills on surfaces; gradients only draw the shutter's slats and rail.
Don't use a module accent anywhere but its own sign board, or a hub colour on a sign board.
Don't set Do Hyeon outside sign boards.
Don't set text in Safety Amber or use it as a fill; it measures 1.4 to 1.7:1 on concrete.
Don't leave an empty grid cell or an empty-state block where a vacant unit belongs.
